request.initial_prompt: Othello. What sense had I of her stol'n hours of lust? I saw't not, thought it not, it harm'd not me. I slept the next night well, was free and merry; I found not Cassio's kisses on her lips. He that is robb'd, not wanting what is stol'n, Let him not know't, and he's not robb'd at all.
